tasks.short: Select codes and create production databases

steps.what: Open the symptoms and the current codes
Select codes that monitor database performance
Sign the codes for these production databases
Enter the signed codes to create production databases

tasks.design: The administrator selects the codes that will monitor database performance and names the production databases those codes may create. A job on {DATA_PLATFORM} enters only that signed set. It does not choose codes, and no agent writes to a database that was not named in the signed version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Codes were typed on a live screen, so there was no set that could be refused.
tasks.enabler_now: The platform can store a code set with a version and run that version as a job.
tasks.still_hard: Which codes are worth running, and whether a new production database should exist, stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator selects the codes and signs the only set the job may enter.

ambition.what: Sign a code set when the symptom is named, not during the next outage

tasks.altitude: Less time retyping codes. The choice of what may create a production database stays with the administrator.

reach.task: Run only the signed code set
reach.learn: Which production databases the set is allowed to create

evidence.claim: Selecting monitoring codes is a short list with a version. Entering them is a job. Choosing the list is not.
Digest [S4] says a coding assistant still needs a person to review what it drafts. The codes here are signed before they are entered.
Digest [S28] reports a coding agent that deleted a production database. This job enters only the signed codes and does not let an agent decide.

assumptions: Focal role is the database administrator. The task ends when the signed codes have been entered.
Input contract: symptom, code text, target database name, version. Producer is the administrator's selection. A code with no target is not entered.
Use the platform's own monitoring configuration before custom code.
unknowns: Which symptoms already have a code the platform provides.
research_questions: How often does a signed code set create a database nobody later uses?

already_counted.description: Selecting which codes matter stays with the administrator
The sign-off is not saved time

incremental.description: Retire a code when the platform already collects that symptom

approvals.approved_version: code set signed for these production databases

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the symptoms are vague, so few codes are signed and the job rarely runs. The high case assumes clean sets, but every set is still selected and signed. An unsigned create is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify the symptoms of database performance
Evaluate hardware and software against the symptoms
Draft a recommendation from that evaluation

loop.input: evaluation notes and the note template
loop.output: a draft that cites symptom ids only
loop.check: Every symptom id is on the extract
loop.stop: Drop a sentence with no symptom id and stop after one draft
loop.why_not_simpler: Whether hardware will help is not a sentence in the template

steps.what: Recommend hardware or software for database performance
Brief upper management on the signed advice

tasks.design: Symptoms on {DATA_PLATFORM} name what is slow. The administrator evaluates hardware and software against those symptoms and signs a recommendation in {DOCS}. A draft may restate the symptom rows. It may not recommend a product the rows do not support. The briefing to the upper manager stays a conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recommendations were slides with no symptom id, so a later reader could not see what had been evaluated.
tasks.enabler_now: A symptom export can be cited by id inside a recommendation note.
tasks.still_hard: Whether hardware or software will actually move the symptom is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator evaluates the options and signs what may be said to management.

ambition.what: Sign a recommendation when the symptom is measured, not at the annual budget meeting

tasks.altitude: Less time rebuilding the symptom table. The evaluation and the briefing stay with the administrator.

reach.task: Decide a purchase from the signed recommendation only
reach.learn: Which symptom the recommendation is about

evidence.claim: A performance recommendation is a symptom, a comparison, and a person who will defend it. A filled table is not that judgement.
Digest [S3] says a prompt can fill document fields and can be wrong. The draft here is checked against the symptom rows before it is signed.
Digest [S28] keeps an unattended change to a live database out of scope. This task recommends. It does not install.

assumptions: Focal role is the database administrator. Buying the hardware is a later decision by the upper manager.
Input contract: symptom id, measure, option name, constraint. Producer is the monitoring export. A symptom with no measure is not recommended on.
Use the platform's own export before a custom collector.
unknowns: Which options the firm is allowed to buy this year.
research_questions: How often does the signed recommendation differ from the first draft?

already_counted.description: The evaluation stays with the administrator

incremental.description: Refresh the option list when a contract changes

approvals.approved_version: recommendation signed for these symptom ids

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes symptom exports are missing, so the note is written by hand and the briefing is unchanged. The high case saves the table assembly only. Evaluation and the briefing are not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Change the database from the manuals

steps.what: Review procedures in the system manuals
Draft the changes those procedures require

loop.input: procedure text and the change template
loop.output: statements that cite a procedure id
loop.check: Each statement quotes a step that is in the extract
loop.stop: Stop a statement that adds a step the procedure does not have
loop.why_not_simpler: Whether this database should take the change is not in the manual

steps.what: Judge whether the changes fit this database
Sign the changes to the database
Apply the signed changes to the database

tasks.design: The administrator reviews the procedures in the database management system manuals on {DOCS}. A draft may propose changes only where a procedure states them. The administrator judges whether those changes fit this database and signs one set. A job on {DATA_PLATFORM} applies only that signed set. An agent does not read the manual and write to the database.
tasks.previous_blocker: Changes were made while reading the manual, so nobody could show which procedure had been followed.
tasks.enabler_now: A procedure can be cited by page and id, and a change can name that id.
tasks.still_hard: A manual procedure can be wrong for this database. That judgement stays human.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator decides which stated procedure becomes a change, and signs it.
tasks.altitude: Less time retyping the procedure. The decision to change this database stays with the administrator.

reach.task: Apply only the signed change set
reach.learn: Which procedure id each change cites

evidence.claim: A manual change is a procedure, a proposed statement, and a person who decides it fits. The manual page is not permission.
Digest [S3] says a prompt can fill document fields and can be wrong. The draft is checked against the procedure text.
Digest [S27] says models wrote vulnerable code in a large share of tests, so a clean draft is not treated as a safe change.
Digest [S28] reports an unattended agent that deleted a production database. This apply runs only the signed statements.

assumptions: Focal role is the database administrator. A change with no procedure id is not applied.
Input contract: manual id, procedure id, proposed statement, target database. Producer is the manual set. A procedure that names a different product is marked out of scope.
Use the platform's own change job before a custom runner.
unknowns: Which manuals match the version that is installed.
research_questions: How often does the signed change differ from the procedure's literal statement?

already_counted.description: Reading the manuals stays with the administrator
Judging fit stays with the administrator

incremental.description: Replace a manual extract when the installed version changes

approvals.approved_version: change set signed against these procedure ids

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the manuals do not match the installed version, so the draft is discarded and the review stays as it is. The high case saves retyping only. Every change is still judged and signed before it is applied.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise management on database system trends

steps.what: Identify industry trends from the named source
Evaluate those trends for these database systems
Draft the advice note for upper management

loop.output: sentences that cite a source id
loop.check: Every source id is on the extract
loop.stop: Drop a sentence with no source and stop after one draft
loop.why_not_simpler: What this firm should buy is not a sentence the template knows

steps.what: Sign the advice for upper management
Brief upper management on the signed advice

tasks.design: The administrator identifies industry trends from named sources in {DOCS} and evaluates which of them touch these database systems. A draft advice note may cite only those sources. The administrator signs it and briefs upper management. The briefing is the advice. A model does not send it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trend notes had no source, so management could not tell a claim from a guess.
tasks.enabler_now: A source can be stored with a title and a date that a note can cite.
tasks.still_hard: Which trend matters for this firm is a judgement, and the conversation with management stays human.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator evaluates the trends and signs the advice before the briefing.

ambition.what: Sign trend advice when a source is dated, not only in the yearly pack

tasks.altitude: Less time collecting clippings. The evaluation and the briefing to upper management stay with the administrator.

evidence.claim: Trend advice is a source, a judgement, and a briefing. A stack of clippings is not advice.
Digest [S3] says a prompt can fill document fields and can be wrong. Claims without a source id are dropped before the note is signed.

assumptions: Focal role is the database administrator. The upper manager decides what to do with the advice.
Input contract: source title, source date, trend sentence, database system name. Producer is the source list. A sentence with no source is not briefed.
Use the document store's citation field before a custom tracker.
unknowns: Which sources the firm already pays for.
research_questions: How often is a drafted claim dropped because the source does not say it?

already_counted.description: Evaluating trends stays with the administrator

incremental.description: Retire a source that is no longer received

approvals.approved_version: advice signed for these source ids

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes sources are unnamed, so the note is written by hand and the briefing is unchanged. The high case saves clipping only. Evaluation and the briefing are not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The administrator stops retyping performance codes, manual extracts and trend notes, and spends the year on which codes may run and what advice management should hear.
reach: Upper managers receive a signed note on database trends instead of a loose slide.
Operators receive only the codes the administrator has signed.
skills_to_grow: Treat a monitoring code as a signed statement, not as a guess a job may invent.
Change a database only from the procedure the manual actually states.
Separate a trend note from a decision to buy hardware.
role.ambitious_version: Every production database is created from a signed code set, and every piece of advice to management names its source.
